protocol.partition: OMPAL Train-only nested fusion OOF; Dev/Test are prohibited
protocol.selection: union of T3 errors, T3+T3 context when Train metadata supplies it, and lowest-margin quantile
protocol.margin_definition: largest uncalibrated LinearSVC decision margin minus runner-up margin
protocol.gold_policy: Rows are preannotations only; human review and adjudication are required. Auto-promotion is prohibited.
protocol.surface_policy: T3+T3 is a review priority, not a surface-tone or correctness label.
